title: offstage: how do local and cloud commands reach isolated, off-screen execution?
audience: Engineers onboarding to offstage (npm CLI/MCP) and offstage cloud
scope: Local route/run across the headless, container and session lanes; cloud sandbox and task flow from the SDK through the Fly plane to fleet slots.
omissions: Clerk sign-in, Stripe billing, Resend mail and GitHub App runner registration (plane)
Fleet upkeep: fleetd reconcile, slot seeding via loopback VNC, recordings, fleet doctor
Marketing site (Vercel), launch film, bench and chaos tooling: not runtime

A2 headless: execa spawn argv → exit code

B1 HTTPS: sandbox create / agent goal / kill
B1 HTTPS Bearer key: task, sandbox, command

B2 HTTPS long-poll ≤25 s: claim, then ops

spawn node -e harness for an agent op

notes.title: Routing and dispatch
notes.text: classify() reads argv and repo configs, never runs them: session > container > headless, plus a refuse flag. run() refuses that on every lane, and a forced headless downgrade, else calls the lane's run(). Cloud: a box's ≤25 s claim long-poll takes a waiting sandbox first, else the fairest task.

notes.title: Where results and state live
notes.text: Local: each run gets .offstage/runs/<id>/ (command.log, screen.png, result.json); a failed write adds a diagnostic, never changes the verdict. Plane: in-memory stores snapshot atomically to /data/plane.json every 2 s if changed and on SIGTERM; in-flight sandbox ops are lost on restart.

notes.title: Failure and isolation
notes.text: Missing substrate → skipped with a fix, never your screen. sessiond checks peer uid and refuses input on-console. Unstarted claims requeue; started work on a lost box fails. No claim without LAN guard; dirty slots reset to a new uid; slots get a run token, not the model key.
